name: duckdb
title: DuckDB
description: Interact with DuckDB, the in-process analytical SQL database, for embedded analytics workloads.
label: database,bigdata

properties.name: databasePath
properties.description: Database path, either :memory: or a relative or absolute file path.

properties.name: batchSize
properties.description: Batch size for insert when the body is a List. 0 inserts all rows in one JDBC batch.

properties.name: format
properties.description: File format for copy: csv, parquet, json or auto (inferred from the file extension).

properties.name: jdbcUrl
properties.description: Full JDBC URL override. When set, databasePath is not used to build the URL.

properties.name: operation
properties.description: The operation to perform: execute, query, insert, copy or ping.

properties.name: query
properties.description: Static SQL for query when the message body is empty.

properties.name: readOnly
properties.description: Open the embedded database file in read-only mode. Only applies to connections created by this endpoint from databasePath or jdbcUrl, and requires an existing database file.

properties.name: resultFormat
properties.description: How query results are returned: LIST_MAP (List of Map) or JSON array string.

properties.name: table
properties.description: Target table for insert and copy operations. Can be overridden per message with the CamelDuckDbTable header.

properties.name: lazyStartProducer
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.
